display_long_description:
**“Superb and probably one of the BEST mech games in VR! - Think HAWKEN but better!”
Paradise Decay Game Reviews** 

Built exclusively for virtual reality, Iron Rebellion delivers a hands-on piloting experience unlike traditional mech games. Climb inside the cockpit of a towering war machine, reach for switches, manage power systems, operate weapons, and physically control every aspect of your mech as you battle for supremacy on the battlefield.

[media]

Iron Rebellion is a seated VR game.

**Tactical Multiplayer Warfare**:
Form elite 8v8 squads to dominate the fight in multiple game modes. Victory depends on teamwork and smart decision-making.

No squad? No problem. Play against bots as you master your skills throughout different game modes.

**Six Unique Mech Classes**:
Choose from six specialized mech classes, each designed for different combat roles and playstyles. Customize your loadout, install augments, refine your strategy, and create a machine tailored to your approach.

**Cross-Platform VR Combat**:
Fight alongside pilots on both PCVR and standalone Quest through a seamless cross-platform multiplayer integration.

[media]

[media]

[media]

**Have More Questions?** 
 Hop into our Discord and join an active community of other mech pilots.
